question: PM-YUVA 3. 0 launched in March 2025 is related to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mentoring Young Authors**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PM-YUVA 3.0**, which stands for **Prime Minister’s Scheme for Mentoring Young Authors**, was launched in March 2025 to promote and mentor budding Indian authors and writers.
 
• The scheme focuses on creating a platform for **young authors (below 30 years of age)** to express their ideas, thoughts, and creativity in various genres such as literature, culture, and history.
 
• Under this initiative, a **nationwide contest is conducted** to identify promising authors, and a select number of winners are provided with mentorship, training, and an opportunity to publish their work.
